description: This file defines the VersionSelectorManager class within the Orleans.Runtime.Versions.Selector namespace. It manages version selection strategies for grain interfaces, providing methods to get, set, and resolve version selectors based on strategies.

classes.name: VersionSelectorManager
classes.description: Manages version selection strategies for grain interfaces, allowing configuration and retrieval of version selectors based on strategies, with support for default and interface-specific selectors.

methods.name: VersionSelectorManager
methods.description: Constructor initializing the manager with dependency injection and configuration options.

methods.name: GetSelector
methods.description: Retrieves the version selector for a specific grain interface type, returning the default if none is set.

methods.name: SetSelector
methods.description: Sets the default version selector based on a strategy.

methods.name: SetSelector
methods.description: Sets or removes the version selector for a specific grain interface type based on a strategy.

methods.name: ResolveVersionSelector
methods.description: Resolves and returns a version selector implementation based on a given strategy.
